name: reference-cartpole-host-controller-interface
status: E01 structural contract; checkpoint and episode protocol require G3E

plant.termination: abs(x)>2.4 or abs(theta)>12 degrees or step_count>10000
plant.runtime_reward: cos(x*pi/(2*2.4))^2 after transition, including terminal step
plant.training_terminal_target: -100 in DQN replay only; not the plant runtime reward

host_to_controller.mask_predicate: uniform <= 0.5; one bit per cell shared by six channels
host_to_controller.optional_noise: float32 [epochs,1,32,32,6], added to delta before masking
host_to_controller.schedule_and_rng_policy: explicit traces at E01 replay seam; not a physical bus requirement; G3E chooses deployed generator/seed boundaries

controller.output_hidden_channels_4_5: accumulate +1 per NCA step at output cells; no inference clipping

controller_to_host.host_role: apply returned action to source plant; no desired-action computation

reset_and_timing_boundary.startup: explicit plant and controller state provision
reset_and_timing_boundary.plant_reset: source random uniform [-0.05,0.05) when invoked with declared RNG
reset_and_timing_boundary.controller_reset: explicit new grid; no implied coupling to plant reset
reset_and_timing_boundary.step_synchronization: one controller decision then one source plant transition
reset_and_timing_boundary.wall_clock_deadline: unselected; 0.02 s is simulated integration time, not proof of a hardware deadline
